text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (The 'Satsuki Sho' is right before my eyes... and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Di-nner time♪ Di-nner ti—
Oh, good evening, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, do you mind if I sit next to you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Here you are.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Alrighty, gotta eat plenty and give it my all again tomorrow~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Special Week-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, y-yes!?
I'm sorry, was I being too loud...!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...If you want, you can have mine too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (The Classic Triple Crown. A once-in-a-lifetime, supreme glory fit to dedicate to my little sister...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I have to seize it... I have to seize it!
Even though I must—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: To fall behind... someone running in the same race as me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...Is she panicking? Is that why?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I don't have the appetite to eat anything—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Geez, Ayabe-san,
if you're in here, at least turn on the lights~
(*Click—*)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: *Mmph*... What is this? ...It's... sweet...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, these are Curren's favorite milk candies!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's suuuper sweet and gives you tons of energy♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...If it's your favorite,
you should just eat it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm the type who loves sharing delicious things~
After all, I am an Umastagrammer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Please eat plenty and keep your spirits high,
Ayabe-san. The Satsuki Sho is coming up soon, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Neither of them were at the Hopeful Stakes—
Top Road-san and Opera O-san, rivals I just can't afford to lose to, will be there too!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (............"A rival I can't afford to lose to"?)

The day of the Satsuki Sho.
As the generation's finest, like T.M. Opera O and Narita Top Road, gather together—

Just as before, Admire Vega splendidly
took first place in that 'Pre-Race Popularity Poll.'
choice_data_list: (Though I doubt she really cares this time either...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's time. ...I'm heading to the paddock.

The magazine she left behind on the table
as she exited the room—

On the well-thumbed page was an article
featuring Narita Top Road and T.M. Opera O
as the standout contenders to watch.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The spectators lost all composure, shouting and clamoring.
Cheers, screams, and an uproar swept through like a storm.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For this is a festival of courage!
This is a festival of heroes!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
The overture has at last drawn to a close!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: From here on, we three heroes shall perform a grand symphony to weave a new era—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And in the very midst of it all, shining the brightest, is me! Me, the Overlord, T.M. Opera O! Behold and bear witness, ladies and gentlemen of the audience!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! Amazing...
Well, I don't really get most of what you're saying, but...
the intensity is awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Still, we're not gonna
lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fans
text_block_list.text:
Top Road-saaan!!
Do your beeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you so much for the cheers!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Please—keep your expectations high.
Because I promise I will live up to them!!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeee~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: An opponent I cannot lose to—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (That kind of thing... is only natural.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (In order to win, in order to attain glory worthy of being offered up, losing to any opponent is simply unacceptable.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I can't lose. Not to those girls, not to anyone.
